The scattering cross-section off nuclei and the production cross-sections at colliders  are in general not governed by the annihilation cross-section. These are three different processes, not necessarily directly related.
There is not “A single quantity” which simulatenously governs annihilations, scatterings and collider production”  
A simple rephrasing should be enough
and to remove "the elastic-scattering rate on nuclei, the production cross section at colliders"
